scope: Canonical ClickHouse outbox enqueue and delivery failures

behavior.enqueue_failures: The outbox preserves OutboxEnqueueError type and transactional behavior while suppressing the underlying database exception text.
behavior.delivery_failures: ClickHouse transport exception details are replaced with a bounded message containing only the exception class before durable last_error storage.
behavior.logs: Delivery logs contain the event key and exception class, not provider exception text. Client setup failures were already class-only and remain unchanged.

focused_checks.command: .venv/bin/python -s -m pytest tests/test_clickhouse_outbox.py tests/test_ingestion_outbox_producers.py tests/test_rpc_indexer_recovery.py tests/test_gnosis_indexer_recovery.py tests/test_eas_indexer_recovery.py tests/test_remote_sensing_scheduler_contract.py -q
coverage: enqueue database failure is fixed-message and suppresses raw exception context
projection conflict remains a distinct typed error
transport failure durable state and logs omit secret-bearing provider detail
retry timing, partial batch completion, transaction ownership, rollback, and upstream producer failure contracts

limitations: No ClickHouse endpoint or PostgreSQL database was contacted.
This does not close real ClickHouse recovery, delivery parity, or production alert routing.
